label: muted zh
js: localStorage.setItem('claudeGames.muted', '1'); localStorage.setItem('claudeGames.lang', 'zh'); location.reload(); 'reload'

label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.step(1); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: help
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); Kit.help.close(); r(JSON.stringify(u)); }, 300))

label: play (roof)
js: game.start({level:'easy'}); game.step(0.5); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: buddy
js: game.step(1.5); game.call(); game.step(1.2); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: pops
js: (() => { game.step(2); game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); const T = w.L.targets; game.put(T[2].f, T[2].x); game.step(0.2); w.robots.push({id:950,f:T[2].f,x:T[2].x+3,home:3,face:-1,st:'walk',t:0,throwCd:9,thrower:false}); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'ArrowRight'})); game.step(0.1); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'ArrowRight'})); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'Space'})); game.step(0.3); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'Space'})); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: pause
js: game.pause(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: all done + garage
js: (() => { game.resume(); const w = game.world(); w.players[0].done = w.L.targets.length - 1; const T = w.L.targets[w.L.targets.length - 1]; game.put(T.f, T.x); game.step(0.3); game.put(0, 0); game.step(0.3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300)); })()

label: van wait
js: (() => { game.start({level:'normal', go:true}); game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); game.put(0, w.L.vanX); game.step(0.3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300)); })()

label: lift only goes up
js: (() => { game.quiet(); const s = game.world().L.shafts[0]; game.put(s.lo, s.x); game.park(s.i, s.lo); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'ArrowDown'})); game.step(0.3); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'ArrowDown'})); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().p.mode, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: clear
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players[0].done = w.L.targets.length; game.put(0, w.L.vanX - 2); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'ArrowRight'})); game.step(0.8); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'ArrowRight'})); game.step(0.4); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().phase, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: next hotel
js: game.step(5); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().b, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300))

label: towel + dodge + bump
js: (() => { game.step(2); game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); game.put(6, 0); w.towels.push({x:3,f:6,vx:-5.2,t:0,y:1.05}); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'KeyZ'})); game.step(1); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'KeyZ'})); w.robots.push({id:951,f:6,x:0.3,home:3,face:-1,st:'walk',t:0,throwCd:9,thrower:false}); game.step(0.4); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200)); })()

label: 2P turn
js: (() => { game.start({players:2, go:true}); game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); game.put(9, 0); w.robots.push({id:952,f:9,x:0.3,home:3,face:-1,st:'walk',t:0,throwCd:9,thrower:false}); game.step(2.2); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().phase, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: 2P hi5
js: game.step(4); game.call(); game.step(0.6); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 300))

label: 2P out + results
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players.forEach(p => p.lives = 1); game.quiet(); game.put(9, 0); w.robots.push({id:953,f:9,x:0.3,home:3,face:-1,st:'walk',t:0,throwCd:9,thrower:false}); game.step(2.2); game.step(3); game.quiet(); game.put(9, 0); w.robots.push({id:954,f:9,x:0.3,home:3,face:-1,st:'walk',t:0,throwCd:9,thrower:false}); game.step(2.2); game.step(3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: 1P won results
js: (() => { game.start({go:true}); const w = game.world(); w.players[0].b = 4; w.players[0].score = 45000; w.phase = 'won'; game.showResults(); game.step(1); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: 1P game over results
js: (() => { game.start({go:true}); const w = game.world(); w.players[0].score = 1500; w.phase = 'over'; game.showResults(); game.step(1); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: english reload
js: localStorage.setItem('claudeGames.lang', 'en'); location.reload(); 'reload'

label: english: CJK on title, help, play, pause, results (the kit's 中文 switch label aside)
js: (() => { game.hold(true); const found = new Set(); const look = () => { const cjk = /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/; const bad = []; document.querySelectorAll('body *').forEach(el => { if (el.closest && el.closest('#kit-lang-btn')) return; for (const n of el.childNodes) if (n.nodeType === 3 && cjk.test(n.textContent)) bad.push(n.textContent.trim()); for (const a of ['title', 'aria-label', 'placeholder']) { const v = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(a); if (v && cjk.test(v)) bad.push(a + ':' + v); } }); bad.forEach(b => found.add(b)); }; look(); Kit.help.open(); look(); Kit.help.close(); game.start({go:true}); game.call(); game.step(1.2); look(); game.pause(); look(); game.resume(); game.world().phase='over'; game.showResults(); look(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { look(); r(JSON.stringify([...found])); }, 300)); })()
